artifacts.label: A：卡片陈列
prompts:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. Design a focused primary screen, not a feature inventory. One real desktop WEB page, content only, no browser chrome, no device mockup or perspective. Target dimensions: 1440 x 1024, natural landscape ratio. Current date is 2026-10-09, Asia/Shanghai. This is a private certificate collection for a logged-in child at 灿然英语工作室, using sample name 小雨.

Use the FOUR attached image references as actual visual grounding:
Reference 1: approved Lesson 1–2 keepsake certificate, blue title 礼貌小帮手, near-view man returning a red handbag to straw-hat woman.
Reference 2: approved Lesson 3–4 keepsake certificate, purple title 认领小达人, near-view cap-wearing customer receiving purple polka-dot umbrella from mustached attendant over a wooden counter.
Reference 3: approved Lesson 5–6 keepsake certificate, sage title 新朋友小使者, Mr. Blake with rectangular glasses and green coat introducing brown-haired coral-dress Sophie to blond boy Hans waving in a mustard jacket.
Reference 4: the exact existing brand symbol, yellow star flower with green leaves.
Preserve the approved certificate designs, character identities, warm ivory textured paper, rounded horizontal certificate proportions, brown outlines, name/title/star/scene layout and gold metal edge. Incorporate the certificates themselves as the collectible objects. Remove the page backgrounds and external buttons from the referenced certificate screenshots when placing the cards. Never warp or arbitrarily crop the certificate or its typography. No wooden cabinet, trophy, medal, cat mascot, cartoon house or unrelated illustrations.

Page design language: warm ivory base #fffdf6, dark cocoa type #4a3226, sage green primary actions, pale sand separators, moderate round corners, restrained shadows, light paper texture. Avoid wrapping the whole page in a bordered panel. Each certificate is a meaningful standalone object; do not nest a box around each certificate. Friendly yet refined, legible rounded Chinese UI typography, no toddler toy aesthetic, no dark dashboard or tech aesthetic. Brown outlined tactile buttons visibly look clickable. Use whitespace and alignment before extra containers or borders.

Common data for all three collectible cards:
- Lesson 1–2, 礼貌小帮手, 小雨, exactly five solid gold stars, full slim gold rim, date 2026.10.07.
- Lesson 3–4, 认领小达人, 小雨, exactly five solid gold stars, full slim gold rim, date 2026.10.08.
- Lesson 5–6, 新朋友小使者, 小雨, exactly THREE solid gold stars followed by TWO hollow brown outline stars, ordinary brown rim with NO gold border and NO date.
Five positions only on every certificate; no stars elsewhere for decoration. Do not imply partial-star cards are full-star achievements.

Global header: modest brand starflower + "灿然英语工作室" left. Clear simple navigation "我的课程", active "我的纪念卡", and small student label "小雨" on the right. Primary page heading "我的纪念卡". Quiet subtitle "小雨 · 3 张纪念卡". No leaderboard, streak, points wallet, shop, games, locked-card grid, search bar, analytics, social sharing or excessive filters. Do not add an implementation explanation or numbered option labels inside the design. Real readable UI sizes, purposeful spacing and enough breathing room.

DIRECTION NAME (metadata only, do not print this label): Paper card gallery.
Render a calm, highly usable collection overview. Main content width about 1140, aligned centrally, header full width. Below title and subtitle, place the THREE horizontal certificate cards in a spacious TWO-COLUMN gallery: Lesson 1–2 at upper left, Lesson 3–4 upper right, Lesson 5–6 lower left. Leave lower-right blank breathing room, not an empty locked placeholder. Certificate cards about 525 by 280 each so all three remain fully visible in this desktop viewport; the printed name, title, stars and scene must remain clear. Keep each card entirely complete and give it a tiny paper-lift shadow and comfortable spacing. Under each card put a small genuine outline button "查看纪念卡" aligned right, not floating text. No repeated lesson titles outside each card. The card itself and this small button lead to its enlarged view; represent a clear tappable surface. Keep collection count modest and no oversized featured card. This is the clean scalable practical option, showing several earned cards at once. The entire screen fits without cut-off certificates.

Refine the attached certificate gallery screenshot with ONLY these precise corrections. Preserve its layout, colors, three illustrations, all Chinese card titles, name 小雨, FIVE star positions and current state, all three 查看纪念卡 buttons, and header brand.

1. Remove the invented handwritten slogan at top right ("用英语看见更大的世界 做更好的自己") and its leaf/underline. Leave clean warm ivory whitespace there.
2. Remove the invented handwritten slogan at bottom right ("每一次相遇 都是成长的礼物") and its leaf/underline. Leave whitespace. NO replacement text, illustrations, ornaments, badges or placeholder box.
3. In the Lesson 5–6 partial-star card at lower left, add a clear small printed footer "Lesson 5–6" inside the card at bottom left, beneath its three solid gold stars and two empty outline stars. It must have an ordinary brown frame and NO date. Make this card a little taller or gently tighten its internal spacing if necessary so the footer and its entire frame and the 查看纪念卡 button below fit within the canvas. Do not shrink the scene disproportionately.
4. Remove the made-up user avatar head at the top right. Keep the simple name label "小雨" with no account dropdown arrow. No extra personal portrait.

Everything else preserved. Clean, refined, accessible web UI screenshot, current date 2026-10-09. Full screen no clipping. Exact output dimensions/aspect same as supplied reference. This is a correction of one design, not a collage. Do not add any new copy.

Render a distinctly different collection experience: a SINGLE LARGE SELECTED CERTIFICATE is the hero, with a compact three-item thumbnail strip for selecting other cards. Preserve global header but make page heading smaller and aligned left within about 1120px content. A quiet small count reads "2 / 3" aligned right above the main certificate. Main selected card is the Lesson 3–4 purple umbrella close-up, fully visible and centered at approximately 850 x 455 pixels. Show a subtle thin layered paper edge behind it to suggest an album, without a bulky leather book, table scene, shelf, simulated spiral binding or tilt. Card stays flat and legible. Put separate circular outlined previous/next arrow BUTTONS outside the left/right edges of the card; do not overlap artwork or create unexplained swipe-only navigation. The rest of the screen has generous warm ivory space.

Below the hero, one compact centered row of three thumbnail buttons, each a faithful small copy of its certificate art. The middle thumbnail has a sage outline indicating selection. Tiny labels directly beneath each thumbnail read exactly "Lesson 1–2", "Lesson 3–4", "Lesson 5–6". The partial Lesson 5–6 thumbnail must retain its brown edge and three-solid-two-hollow stars. Beneath the thumbnail row put one centered green PRIMARY button "保存纪念卡", about 230 by 52px, and next to it a smaller warm ivory outlined button "返回课程". No other actions, text paragraphs, decorations or achievement stats. No card gallery grid, no timeline. This page conveys a personal keepsake album and lets the child enjoy one card at a time. All content fits the specified viewport with ample margin, controls do not look disabled, the artwork proportions remain intact.
